texts.hero.sub: Festive panjabis and soft winter knits, designed in Bangladesh for how we live now.
texts.collections.men: Banded collars, woven yokes and quiet embroidery. Made for Eid, weddings and every Jummah in between.
texts.collections.women: Mock-necks and crews in soft, fine-gauge knits and colours that warm up a Bangladeshi winter.
texts.story.text: Hololand began with a simple idea: the clothes we wear to celebrate should feel as good as they look. We take the panjabi our fathers wore and the knits our mothers layered, and tailor them for a new Bangladesh, confident, colourful and entirely our own.
